args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to production, the service started failing health checks in all regions (healthy=false, error rate 18%). v2.3.1-rc had also been marked unhealthy in staging. The SRE agent rolled checkout-api back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback finished and was verified. Next steps: confirm recovery and find the root cause in v2.3.1 before redeploying it.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions and opened a SEV2 incident. The service is healthy again.

- **What went wrong:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate, v2.3.1-rc, had also been marked unhealthy in staging before the deploy.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to it. The rollback finished in all three regions. Afterwards the service shows healthy with a 0.2% error rate.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) is open and the on-call engineer has been paged. It describes the failure, the rollback and the next steps: confirm recovery and find the root cause in v2.3.1 before redeploying it.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
